claim: Before a live turn, check the evaluator with a reference answer that scores zero, and compute every number you put in a prompt from the evaluator instead of typing it. The reference answer proves the evaluator can be satisfied and caught my own wrong reference (the identifier check ran before the fixed-wall check, which broke six existing tests that require E_OWNER first). A case count typed into a prompt was 24 when the evaluator had 28, and the outer seat noticed.
conditions: evaluator reference answer scores zero prompt numbers computed baseline

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: evaluator_real2 baseline 10 and reference 600 exposed the ordering mistake; with the fixed-wall check first the reference scored 0; the outer seat's turn-2 review flagged the 24-versus-28 mismatch.
